tasks.title: Create NotFoundPage component
tasks.description: Create a reusable NotFoundPage component in packages/cli/web/src/components/NotFoundPage.tsx. It renders a centered 404 message with a React Router <Link to="/"> back to the board. Style consistently with existing page layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: NotFoundPage component exists and exports correctly
Contains a <Link to='/'> with 'Back to board' text
Uses React Router Link (not <a>) for navigation

tasks.title: Fix IssueDetailPage infinite loading on API error
tasks.description: In IssueDetailPage.tsx, destructure isError from useIssue and add an early return rendering NotFoundPage before the existing isLoading guard. This fixes the infinite 'Loading...' spinner when the API returns 404 or any error.
acceptanceCriteria: useIssue destructures isError in addition to data and isLoading
isError guard renders NotFoundPage before the isLoading guard
isLoading guard still shows 'Loading...' for legitimate slow loads
No infinite spinner on 404 or 500 API errors

tasks.title: Replace IssueCard <a> with React Router <Link>
tasks.description: In IssueCard.tsx, replace the <a href> element with React Router's <Link to> component. Add the Link import from react-router-dom. All existing className, style, and nested content remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Card click navigates without full page reload
Nested buttons (Resume, etc.) still work via stopPropagation

tasks.title: Add catch-all 404 route in App.tsx
tasks.description: In App.tsx, add <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} /> as the last child of the ProjectGuard layout route. Import NotFoundPage. This ensures unmatched paths render the 404 page with Header visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Catch-all * route added as last child of ProjectGuard layout route

tasks.title: Build and typecheck verification
tasks.description: Run the web build and typecheck to verify all changes compile correctly with no regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build succeeds in packages/cli
